edits.before: From 3 through 6 the lane swings firmly to you. Your E Abscond gap-close beats her single W slow, and once you're on top of her, her ball is only single-target peel that Petricite Burst can soak. Bait her E Command Protect shield with an auto, then unload Q Chain Lash into W Kingslayer for a winning trade. At 6 you either Hijack her Command Shockwave for a huge engage or simply E Abduct past her poke to finish an immobile target.
